method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Reference shows the append-only explanation banner; built has a long paragraph under the title instead.
Reference: kind badges (EDIT/SETTINGS/RESTORE/CREATE), hash, metadata line; built: single row with icon and text. Fixture has one revision.
All/Created/Edited/Deleted/Restored/Settings chips present; built adds date pickers.
Reference shows a detail card with diff and Restore action; built exposes a Diff button per row.

defects.summary: Timeline kind badges and detail card differ from the reference

deviations.reason: The fixture database has one history revision (the first save); the reference shows an authored eight-revision timeline. Data, not chrome.
